info.name: Microsoft Graph Groups API
info.description:
Create and manage Microsoft Entra security groups, Microsoft 365 groups, and distribution lists via Microsoft Graph. Manage group members, owners, and settings. Groups enable efficient entitlement management — granting users access to resources, licenses, and applications as a unit. Supports both v1.0 and beta Microsoft Graph endpoints.

Contact Support:
 Name: Microsoft Graph Support
